title: The 4 Best Countertop Ice Makers for Entertaining and Parties
h1: The 4 Best Countertop Ice Makers for Entertaining and Parties
metaDescription: Our 4 picks for countertop ice makers for entertaining and parties, with key specs, strengths and limitations for each, based on manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports.
lede: We looked at countertop ice makers for entertaining and parties using manufacturer specs, independent reviews and owner reports. Each pick lists what it does well and where it falls short, so you can match it to how you'll use it.

products.name: GE Profile Opal 2.0 Nugget Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 38 lbs of nugget ice per 24 hours, 0.75-gallon side water tank, WiFi with SmartHQ app scheduling.
strengths: Highest sustained output in this list, keeps up with a full afternoon of scooping
Side tank means you're not refilling mid-party the way a small-reservoir machine requires
App scheduling lets you start production hours ahead without being in the kitchen
limitations: Widest footprint here, needs a dedicated spot on the counter or a cart
Overkill for a small get-together of 4 to 6 people
features: 38 lbs of nugget ice per 24 hours
First batch ready in about 10 minutes

products.name: Euhomy Nugget Ice Maker Countertop
products.blurb: Key specs: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day, First batch ready in about 6 minutes, Self-cleaning cycle.
strengths: 34 lbs a day covers most house-party sizes at a fraction of the GE Opal's price
6-minute batch cycle is the fastest recovery time in this list
Carry handle makes it easy to move to a bar cart or outdoor table for the event
limitations: Reservoir is smaller than the GE Opal's side tank, needs more frequent topping off during a long party
Fewer total owner ratings than the more established brands here
features: Up to 34 lbs of nugget ice per day
First batch ready in about 6 minutes
Compact footprint versus the GE Opal

products.name: Frigidaire Countertop Ice Maker
products.blurb: Key specs: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day, 9 pieces ready in about 7 minutes, Simple one-button operation.
strengths: Lowest price point in this list by a wide margin
26 lbs a day comfortably covers a gathering of 6 to 10 guests
Simple enough to hand off to a co-host without instructions
limitations: Bullet ice melts faster than nugget ice, needs more frequent bin checks during a party
Output ceiling means it's not the right pick for a party of 20-plus
No self-cleaning function, needs manual maintenance after heavy use
features: 26 lbs of bullet-shaped ice per day
